title: SoL-Pi sol-pi.json policy v1 (shared host-port)
description: Operator sol-pi.json for kvnloo/sol-pi-hermes and kvnloo/sol-pi-omp. Keys match NVlabs/SoL-Pi version 1. This is shared POLICY across two host ports, not a third plugin ABI. ObservationPack FULL_SENDS and thresholdBytes are implementation constants in $defs, not operator keys (unknown keys are rejected).

actionFusion.description: Optional follow-up then_run on file mutation.

observationPack.description: Archive large tool results and project placeholders after FULL_SENDS.

evidencePreservingReducer.description: Quote-verified reduction of long diagnostic logs.

evidencePreservingReducerProvider.description: Optional EPR provider namespace in the host model registry.

onlineContextCompact.description: Plan-boundary compact only after the host settle event.

cacheWriteReadRatio.description: OCC cache-write / cache-read economic ratio. Default 12.5.

observationPackConstants.title: ObservationPack constants (not sol-pi.json keys)
observationPackConstants.description: Hardcoded in NVlabs/SoL-Pi ObservationPack. Both host ports must match. Do not add these names to the operator file.

FULL_SENDS.description: Provider requests that still carry the full payload before the placeholder takes over.

thresholdBytes.description: Only tool results larger than 10 * 1024 bytes participate.
